title: Anthropic launches Claude Haiku 5.5, the first Haiku model with effort controls, for high-volume, cost-sensitive tasks like summaries and classification (Anthropic)
summary: Anthropic: Anthropic launches Claude Haiku 5.5, the first Haiku model with effort controls, for high-volume, cost-sensitive tasks like summaries and classification — Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5: the cheapest, fastest, and most capable small model we've ever released. Claude Haiku 5.5 is designed for high-volume, cost-sensitive tasks.
